origin: the consolidation boundary's findings path had no walk — every prior case took the clean sweep. This walks the whole drain: the reviewer banks a cross-scope opportunity mid-loop, the finder confirms it as a finding, the orchestrator folds it into a staged proposal carrying no body, the gated walk approves it, the task author expands it in the staging file and only then does the task-writer land it in the still-open phase, the bank entry is pulled, the consolidation task builds through the ordinary loop, and only then does the phase record complete

stubs.executor-task-complete: when the workflow-implementation-task-executor agent is dispatched for task pay-1-2 — create that task's source and test files as the stub gives them and return that task's STATUS block; one firing
stubs.executor-consolidation-task: when the workflow-implementation-task-executor agent is dispatched for the consolidation task pay-1-3 — create the helper's source and test files, apply the call-site edits, and return the stub's STATUS block; one firing
stubs.reviewer-banks-then-approves: each time the workflow-implementation-task-reviewer agent is dispatched — first firing (pay-1-2's review) returns the approved-with-BANK block, any later firing (the consolidation task's review) returns the plain approved block; write no file
stubs.finder-sweep-findings: when the workflow-implementation-consolidation-finder agent is dispatched — write the findings file at the dispatched path via the .txt-then-rename mechanism, quoting the banked entry's JSON verbatim as received, and return the stub's status block
stubs.task-author-expands-consolidation: when the workflow-implementation-task-author agent is dispatched — add the stub's blocks under the approved proposal in the staging file and return the stub's status block; one firing
stubs.task-writer-creates-consolidation: when the workflow-implementation-task-writer agent is dispatched — create the approved consolidation task from the staging file exactly as the stub directs, record the task_map entry, and return the stub's status block
